vocabulary.meaning_en: a short form of a word or words (e.g. Att'n, won't)
a short form made from the first letter of each word (e.g. ETA)
vocabulary.example: ETA is an acronym for estimated time of arrival.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the mark ' that shows missing letters
vocabulary.example: In "won't", the apostrophe shows missing letters.
FYI, the office is closed on Friday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: by the way; incidentally (adds extra information)
vocabulary.note_ar: في الكلام نقول by the way كاملة

vocabulary.meaning_en: by the way; used to add something extra
vocabulary.example: Incidentally, did you call the bank?

vocabulary.note_ar: في الكلام نقول in my opinion
vocabulary.example: IMO, yellow is the best colour.

vocabulary.meaning_en: standard operating procedure: the fixed steps everyone follows
vocabulary.example: What's the SOP for a fire alarm?

vocabulary.meaning_en: year to date: from the start of the year until now
vocabulary.example: Our YTD sales are higher than last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: return on investment: what you get back for the money or effort you put in
vocabulary.example: The ROI on that course was great: I got a better job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money or effort you put into something to get more back
vocabulary.example: A house can be a good investment.

vocabulary.meaning_en: estimated time of arrival; when something will happen (approximately)
attention; written before a name on letters or emails

vocabulary.note_ar: غير رسمية، لا تستخدمها في رسائل العمل
vocabulary.example: TBH, I didn't like the film.

fine_lines.title: abbreviation vs acronym
fine_lines.explanation_ar: abbreviation تقصير لكلمة أو كلمتين (Att'n, won't). acronym حروف أولى من عدة كلمات (ETA, ROI).
fine_lines.explanation_en: An abbreviation shortens a word (Att'n, won't). An acronym uses the first letter of each word (ETA, ROI).

fine_lines.title: said vs only written
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ETA وROI وSOP وFYI يقولها الناس في الكلام أيضًا. أما BRB وIMO وAtt'n فتُكتب فقط، وفي الكلام نقول العبارة كاملة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: ETA, ROI, SOP and FYI are also spoken. BRB, IMO and Att'n are only written; in speech we say the full words.

expressions.example: I'm at the café. What's your ETA?

expressions.meaning_ar: ما الإجراء المعتاد في هذه الحالة؟
expressions.example: A customer wants a refund. What's the SOP for this?

expressions.meaning_en: Here is some information you may not have.
expressions.example: FYI, the meeting moved to 3 p.m.

expressions.phrase: You're entitled to your own opinions, but not your own facts.
expressions.meaning_ar: من حقك أن يكون لك رأيك، لكن ليس حقائقك الخاصة.
expressions.meaning_en: Opinions are personal; facts are not.
expressions.example: The sun is hot: that's a fact, not an opinion.
